title: 티 나게 신경 쓰는 걸 들켜버려서

story.text: 용머리해안, 파도에 깎인 기암절벽을 따라 걷는 길이 아찔했다. 용우가 내 손목을 슬쩍 붙잡는다.
story.reading: yong-meo-ri-hae-an, pa-do-e kkakk-in gi-am-jeol-byeok-eul tta-ra geot-neun gil-i a-jjil-haet-da. yong-u-ga nae son-mok-eul seul-jjak but-jab-neun-da.
story.en: Along Yongmeori Coast, the path along wave-carved cliffs was dizzying. Yongwoo quietly grabs my wrist.

story.text: '절벽 쪽으로 너무 붙지 마라. 바람 세게 불면 위험하다.' 앞장서 걸으며 계속 뒤를 힐끔거린다.
story.reading: jeol-byeok jjog-eu-ro neo-mu but-ji ma-ra. ba-ram se-ge bul-myeon wi-heom-ha-da. ap-jang-seo geot-eu-myeo gye-sok dwi-reul hil-kkeum-geo-rin-da.
story.en: 'Don't get too close to the cliff. It's dangerous if the wind picks up.' He walks ahead but keeps glancing back at me.

story.text: 사진을 찍는 척하며 렌즈 너머로 내 쪽을 보는 그의 시선을 눈치채고 말았다.
story.reading: sa-jin-eul jjik-neun cheok-a-myeo ren-jeu neo-meo-ro nae jjog-eul bo-neun geu-ui si-seon-eul nun-chi-chae-go mal-at-da.
story.en: I noticed his gaze, pretending to take photos but really looking at me through the lens.

story.text: 산방산 전망대에서 잠깐 앉아 쉬는데, 몰래 훔쳐보는 그의 시선이 자꾸 느껴진다. 눈이 마주치자 화들짝 고개를 돌린다.
story.reading: san-bang-san jeon-mang-dae-e-seo jam-kkan anj-a swi-neun-de, mol-lae hum-chyeo-bo-neun geu-ui si-seon-i ja-kku neu-kkyeo-jin-da. nun-i ma-ju-chi-ja hwa-deul-jjak go-gae-reul dol-lin-da.
story.en: Resting for a moment at the Sanbangsan viewpoint, I keep feeling his gaze on me on the sly. When our eyes meet, he startles and turns his head away.

story.text: '왜 자꾸 쳐다봐요?' 묻자 용우 얼굴이 순식간에 붉어진다. 들킨 게 분명한데도 아니라고 우긴다.
story.reading: wae ja-kku chyeo-da-bwa-yo? mut-ja yong-u eol-gul-i sun-sik-gan-e bulg-eo-jin-da. deul-kin ge bun-myeong-han-de-do a-ni-ra-go u-gin-da.
story.en: 'Why do you keep looking at me?' I ask, and Yongwoo's face turns red instantly. Clearly caught, but he insists it's not what it looks like.

story.text: '그, 그런 거 아니다. …아 진짜, 티 나게 왜 자꾸 쳐다보게 만드는데.' 스스로도 당황해서 딴청을 부린다.
story.reading: geu, geu-reon geo a-ni-da. a jin-jja, ti na-ge wae ja-kku chyeo-da-bo-ge man-deu-neun-de. seu-seu-ro-do dang-hwang-hae-seo ttan-cheong-eul bu-rin-da.
story.en: 'Th-that's not it. ...Ugh, seriously, why do you keep making me stare so obviously.' He flusters, pretending to busy himself with something else.

story.text: 새빨개진 귀를 보며 웃음을 참는데, 용우가 헛기침하며 화제를 돌린다. '웃지 말고, 오늘 대화나 잘 들어봐라. 절벽 마을 사람들 얘기다.'
story.reading: sae-ppal-gae-jin gwi-reul bo-myeo us-eum-eul cham-neun-de, yong-u-ga heot-gi-chim-ha-myeo hwa-je-reul dol-lin-da. us-ji mal-go, o-neul dae-hwa-na jal deul-eo-bwa-ra. jeol-byeok ma-eul sa-ram-deul yae-gi-da.
story.en: I try to hold back a laugh at his reddened ears, and Yongwoo clears his throat, changing the subject. 'Don't laugh, just listen to today's conversations. They're about the people of this cliffside village.'

words.example_en: Yongmeori Coast is famous for its wave-carved cliffs.

words.example: 그는 몰래 내 쪽을 훔쳐보고 있었다.
words.example_reading: geu-neun mol-lae nae jjog-eul hum-chyeo-bo-go iss-eot-da
words.example_en: He was secretly stealing glances at me.

words.example: 몰래 쳐다본 걸 결국 들키고 말았다.
words.example_reading: mol-lae chyeo-da-bon geol gyeol-guk deul-ki-go mal-at-da
words.example_en: In the end, he got caught secretly staring.
Even though he tried to hide it, it kept showing.

words.example: 그의 시선이 자꾸 내 쪽으로 향했다.
words.example_reading: geu-ui si-seon-i ja-kku nae jjog-eu-ro hyang-haet-da
words.example_en: His gaze kept turning toward me.

sentences.ko: 용머리해안의 기암절벽을 따라 걷는 길은 아찔할 만큼 아름다웠다.
sentences.reading: yong-meo-ri-hae-an-ui gi-am-jeol-byeok-eul tta-ra geot-neun gil-eun a-jjil-hal man-keum a-reum-da-un-da
sentences.en: The path along Yongmeori Coast's jagged cliffs was dizzyingly beautiful.

sentences.ko: 그는 사진을 찍는 척하며 몰래 내 쪽을 바라보고 있었다.
sentences.reading: geu-neun sa-jin-eul jjik-neun cheok-a-myeo mol-lae nae jjog-eul ba-ra-bo-go iss-eot-da
sentences.en: He pretended to take photos while secretly glancing my way.

sentences.ko: 눈이 마주치자 그는 들킨 걸 알면서도 아니라고 우겼다.
sentences.reading: nun-i ma-ju-chi-ja geu-neun deul-kin geol al-myeon-seo-do a-ni-ra-go u-gyeot-da
sentences.en: When our eyes met, he insisted it wasn't what it looked like, even though he clearly knew he'd been caught.

sentences.ko: '티 나게 왜 자꾸 쳐다보게 만드는데'라며 그는 얼굴을 붉혔다.
sentences.reading: ti na-ge wae ja-kku chyeo-da-bo-ge man-deu-neun-de-ra-myeo geu-neun eol-gul-eul bulk-yeot-da
sentences.en: 'Why do you keep making me stare so obviously,' he said, his face flushing red.

sentences.ko: 그의 시선을 느낄 때마다 나는 못 본 척 고개를 돌렸다.
sentences.reading: geu-ui si-seon-eul neu-kkil ttae-ma-da na-neun mot bon cheok go-gae-reul dol-lyeot-da
sentences.en: Every time I felt his gaze, I turned my head away, pretending not to notice.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.en: Captain, you've been staring at me this whole time, haven't you?

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: 무, 무슨 소리야, 절벽 구경한 거지.
turns.reading: mu, mu-seun so-ri-ya, jeol-byeok gu-gyeong-han geo-ji.
turns.en: Wh-what are you talking about, I was looking at the cliffs.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.text: 근데 왜 카메라는 저를 향해 있었을까요?
turns.reading: geun-de wae ka-me-ra-neun jeo-reul hyang-hae iss-eoss-eul-kka-yo?
turns.en: Then why was the camera pointed at me?

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: …배경으로 잘못 들어간 거다. 그, 그만 좀 캐물어라.
turns.reading: bae-gyeong-eu-ro jal-mot deul-eo-gan geo-da. geu, geu-man jom kae-mul-eo-ra.
turns.en: ...You just got in the shot by mistake. St-stop grilling me about it.

dialogues.question: 이 대화에서 용우의 태도로 가장 알맞은 설명은?
dialogues.question_en: What best describes Yongwoo's attitude in this conversation?
dialogues.correct_answer: 몰래 쳐다본 걸 들키자 당황해서 서툴게 변명하고 있다
options: 몰래 쳐다본 걸 들키자 당황해서 서툴게 변명하고 있다
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 몰래 쳐다본 걸 손님에게 들키자 당황하며 서툴게 변명하고 있습니다.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.en: Why is your face so red?

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: 햇볕이 세서 그렇지, 뭘 그렇게 봐.
turns.reading: haet-byeot-i se-seo geu-reo-chi, mwol geu-reo-ke bwa.
turns.en: The sun's strong, that's why. Why are you staring so much.

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: …아, 됐다, 몰라. 그냥 신경 쓰이니까 그런 거지, 뭐 어쩌라고.
turns.reading: a, dwaet-da, mol-la. geu-nyang sin-gyeong sseu-i-ni-kka geu-reon geo-ji, mwo eo-jjeo-ra-go.
turns.en: ...Ah, forget it, I don't know. It just bothers me, okay, what do you want me to do about it.

dialogues.question: 용우가 '햇볕이 세서 그렇다'고 한 말에 대한 가장 알맞은 설명은?
dialogues.question_en: What best explains Yongwoo's excuse that 'the sun is strong'?
dialogues.correct_answer: 얼굴이 붉어진 진짜 이유를 숨기기 위한 서툰 변명이다
options: 얼굴이 붉어진 진짜 이유를 숨기기 위한 서툰 변명이다
dialogues.explanation: 그늘인데도 햇볕 핑계를 댄 것은, 얼굴이 붉어진 진짜 이유(설렘)를 숨기려는 서툰 변명이었습니다.
